+ Frontend Developer & Designer · Accra, Ghana

Engineering modern solutions for real-world impact.

After SHS, I taught myself to code through YouTube tutorials and began building websites for family and friends' businesses. Those early projects grew into freelance work.

Today I focus on frontend development and design with MadeBySebi and have built for Lucenex Corp. I share more of what I make on GitHub.
